d: 'The Universal Kernel Transform generally refers to theoretical frameworks in machine learning that use kernel methods to map complex data into a unified, high-dimensional space. However, in specific esoteric and symbolic contexts — such as the Universal Kernel Transform Protocol (UKTP) — it refers to architectural routing rules and lawful emergence guidelines for processing semiotic or symbolic structures.' Two domains: 1. Machine Learning & Mathematics (Gaussian RBF, RKHS), 2. Symbolic/Semiotic (UKTP). Zenodo 'UNIVERSAL KERNEL TRANSFORM PROTOCOL (UKTP) v1.1' first organic. arXiv 'Universal kernels via harmonic analysis on Riemannian symmetric spaces' (Steinert, 2025, Cited by 3) second organic. Archive's protocol sits alongside legitimate ML mathematics.
